title: Sekoya confident about its premium blueberries in Asian, Chinese markets
summary: Interview-based trade article by Jing Zang on SEKOYA's positioning in Asian and Chinese markets. States a SEKOYA membership figure of 15.
why_it_matters: Documents the platform's Asian market intent and supplies the competing membership count that conflicts with Fall Creek's own figure of 14.

commercial_position.rationale: China is the highest-growth premium blueberry market and platform entry there is competitively material.

monitoring.rationale: Chinese market developments move quickly and warrant regular re-checking.
